question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To kick the bucket
solution:
The correct answer is "**To die.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **The idiom "to kick the bucket" means to die.**
 
• This idiom is considered informal and is often used in casual conversations or humorous contexts.
 
• Some synonyms for "to kick the bucket" include "to pass away," "to expire," and "to depart this life."
 
 
• Example: Every one of us will kick the bucket someday.
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that option 4 explains the meaning of the given idiom.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
